answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The zephyr lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dune is where a second reviewer recomputes them. What survives to the raven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
